name: The Tale of the Unpainted Promise
source:
Wendy is a talented art student unsure of her skills, while attending a blind garage sale with her sister, she is saddled with a strange unfinished painting that seems to beckon to her... and keeps all others away.

[From [url=https://espoirduvide.itch.io/tale-of-the-unpainted-promise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
温迪是一名才华横溢的艺术学生，她对自己的技能并不确定，在与姐姐参加一场盲目的车库拍卖时，她背负着一幅奇怪的未完成的画作，这幅画似乎在向她招手……并让其他人望而却步。

[来自[url=https://espoirduvide.itch.io/tale-of-the-unpainted-promise]Itch.io[/url]]
